_about: Which test covers each 🐛 report (owner, 2026-10-13: every 🐛 becomes a test). Applied on server start (feedbacklinks.js): sets the report's test_ref and marks it fixed — only if its note starts with note_starts (so a different database can't be touched). feedback-backlog.test.js checks every named test exists.
